entities.name: Théâtre de la Gaîté-Montparnasse
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Théâtre de la Gaîté-Montparnasse is a venue situated at 26, rue de la Gaîté, in the Montparnasse quarter of Paris, in the 14th arrondissement. It opened in 1868 and seats 399 people.
